report_discrepancies.note: The trimmed PDF holds two different proprietary statements of revenues, expenses and changes in net position: p7 (report p10) ends at net position 1,788,385 (ties to the Statement of Net Position p6 and the government-wide p1), p16 (report p38) ends at 1,855,528 with different charges, expenses and beginning net position (1,503,448). p7 was used for the business-type roll-forward.

The Water/Sewer combining schedule (report p44) ties to the p16 version: Combined Utility charges for services 382,352 vs 386,134 on p7; operating expenses 336,603 vs 346,973. Detail recorded as printed on p18.

notes: Modified cash basis (recorded as cash). Governmental lines from the Totals column of the governmental funds statement (p4-p5); beginning/ending cash = governmental fund balances 1,044,869 / 1,133,539 (p5), which include certificates of deposit and cash with county treasurer. Taxes 501,433 split using the Statement of Activities general revenues (p2), which tie to the General Fund (p11) and Street Fund (p13) tax lines. Intergovernmental 585,344 split by the fund schedules p11, p13, p15 (homestead, prorate, in lieu, property tax relief, NPPD lease and franchise fees out of state aid). Miscellaneous 212,945 split by p11, p13, p15 lines. Business-type: Combined Utility + Sanitation from p7 (operating + nonoperating); interest expense 568 recorded as debt service interest. Detail: General Fund combining schedule by department column (p11-p12), Street Fund schedule (p13), nonmajor combining statement (p15, 4 funds), proprietary Water/Sewer combining schedule (p18) and Sanitation from the p7 column. The all-funds budget statement (p10) is not recorded (per-fund schedules exist). Balance sheet: Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis, Total column (includes capital assets and debt).
